name: Gallery runs sideways
look: The section holds under its h2 while one row of 5 to 8 photographs runs sideways with the scroll, the first on the page's left edge, the last ending on the right; each photograph pans 12% inside its frame as it crosses.

phone: Nothing is held under 900px: the same row swipes sideways with snap points.
